keywords.def: Working for yourself and earning income directly from buyers, rather than for an employer who pays a wage.
An office support worker at the front desk who welcomes visitors, answers calls, sets appointments and keeps records.
The most common copier error: paper gets stuck inside, often from wrong size, poor loading or paper dust.
The part of a market whose customers share features such as age, location, income and lifestyle.

en.text: Self-employment needs practical skills. A receptionist needs communication, customer service, multitasking, welcoming body language, interpersonal skills, calm under pressure and computer skills. Photocopiers need correct use and regular maintenance. A small enterprise needs a well-chosen product, a target market and good advertising.

screens.title: Unit summary
paras: A good receptionist has excellent verbal communication, active listening and customer service, connects callers and visitors with the right people, stays polite and works under pressure.
A photocopier is key office equipment. Regular maintenance gives better copies, fewer breakdowns and a longer life, and can be the base of a small business.
To sell goods and services: select a product, state its target market, advertise it, and identify resources and costs.

screens.text: A young person wants to start a photocopy service near a university. Which plan uses all three parts of this unit?
opts: Greet customers warmly, maintain the copier regularly, and advertise to students as the target market
Buy a copier and never clean it
